lines.text: The psalm calls all the earth to make a joyful noise to God and sing the glory of His name.
God turned the sea into dry land, and the people passed through the waters on foot and rejoiced in Him.
God rules forever by His power, and His eyes watch the nations, so the rebellious must not exalt themselves.
God tested His people and refined them like silver, and they went through fire and water before He brought them into exile.
The psalmist invites the kings of the earth to come and listen to what God has done for him.
